100-card singleton, most-played format

Commander

Commander is 100-card singleton led by a legendary creature. The format page mixes public Duel Commander (1v1) leagues with Goldfish Commander lists so the legend hub can show 200+ names with at least five lists each. Color identity is the same rule used at a four-player Commander night.

1986lists
132events
1061pilots

2026-05-12 – 2026-09-11sample

Browse by commander — one page per legend, with every public list we have for that name.

These are Duel Commander (1v1) league tables plus Goldfish public Commander lists. Color identity and the 100-card singleton rule are the same as a four-player Commander night. Partner commanders are listed under both names when the source reports them that way.
